description_en: Updates the owner of a task flow by calling the UpdateTaskFlowOwner operation
name: UpdateTaskFlowOwner

parameters.help_en:
The tenant ID.
You can view the tenant ID by hovering over the profile icon in the upper-right corner of the console. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.help_zh:
租户ID。
取自系统右上角头像处悬停展示的租户ID信息，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.name: tid

parameters.help_en: The task flow ID, which uniquely identifies the task flow. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/424689.html operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 任务流ID，任务流的唯一标识。可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/424689.html接口获取该参数的值
parameters.name: dag_id

parameters.help_en: The user ID of the new owner. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/147098.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141938.html operation to obtain the UserId value
parameters.help_zh: 新Owner的用户ID。可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/147098.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141938.html获取UserId的值
parameters.name: new_owner_id
